themes.title: Verify AI-built workflows before running them
themes.reason: Direct evidence of teachable verification habits and judgment. Add routine evidence to the existing theme. Tom's overconfidence is counterpoint evidence; Ben's caution is positive evidence. Tom's company remains unknown, and his evidence is retained. Ranking is provisional pending human review.

evidence.label: Positive evidence: checking AI reasoning

themes.title: Define human approval gates for consequential actions
themes.reason: Evidence supports teaching approval boundaries and who should approve destructive actions. Keep in the review queue until a human decides whether this is separate from verify-ai. Do not automatically add it to the research file. Ranking is provisional.

evidence.speaker: Aisha Okafor
evidence.quote: We put an approval step in front of anything that deletes or disables. I don't let the Assistant touch production without a person clicking approve.
evidence.label: Positive evidence: human approval for consequential actions

evidence.speaker: Lena Fischer
evidence.quote: Who approves what is the real question for us. Right now anyone on the team can approve a run that deletes things.
evidence.label: Education opportunity: approval authority and judgment

themes.title: Prove one workflow before expanding automation
themes.reason: A concrete example supports teaching scope control and proving a workflow before expanding. Keep in the review queue until a human approves it; do not automatically add it to the research file. Ranking is provisional.

evidence.speaker: Lena Fischer
evidence.quote: My team wanted to automate everything at once. I made them pick one workflow and prove it first.
evidence.label: Positive evidence: start with one proven workflow
